_doc: Minds of the copies (the mind Edge Function). firstWakeMs: after landing, the first copy wakes; staggerMs between copies; wakeMinutes: how often each copy wakes while you play; mailSecondsPerLy: letters cross space at this speed (same star: instant); bubbleMs: how long a song stays up; bubbleScale: song bubbles are this much smaller (padding and max width; the pixel font itself is never scaled, it drops rows). canned: what copies say when playing from this device (?local), no model involved. canned.tells / canned.answers: what the canned mind (?local, headless tests) tells the original, and answers when talked to. paused: Steve, 2026-10-27: "lets stop the api waking them up and having them do and think stuff". While true no copy is woken: the function refuses every wake, the hourly away run included, before it calls the model (since 2026-10-29 the game always asks and the function's answer decides, so a pause or a resume needs no new build of the game). Copies still walk, work and live by the game's own rules; a copy born WAKE stays blank (it becomes itself at its first wake); talking shows its last word. The canned mind of ?local (no model) is not paused, so the playtests keep running it. Set false and redeploy the function (tools/build-mind-kit.mjs copies it) to wake them again. Resumed 2026-10-29 (Steve: turn the minds back on, so a blank copy becomes itself).

relay._doc: Tamsin's Relay Cairn (designs.json cairn, the maker 2026-11-20 pm): two stars where a finished cairn stands hear each other within hopLy light years; a letter between two stars joined by a chain of them takes secondsPerHop for every hop (src/world/galaxy.ts relayHops), when that is sooner than light

almanac._doc: Watcher's Flare Almanac (designs.json almanac, the maker 2026-11-21 pm): every watch kept on a world where a finished one stands also writes the star's temper into the archive (src/world/galaxy.ts starTemper, from its spectral class: a red dwarf from M restlessFromM on is fully convective and flares in bursts, as Ross 154 does; a white dwarf or a brown dwarf is dim and still; the rest are steady). The Watchglass carries those watches to the other Watchglass worlds (src/core/network.ts almanacOf); a ship flying to a star the almanac knows as restless spends extraCells more

tidewhisper._doc: Vigil's Tidewhisper (designs.json tidewhisper, the maker 2026-11-22 am): on a world where a finished dish stands, the last watch kept on the nearest other Tidewhisper world (kept after both stood) arrives as a faint pulse, pulseHours after its light would have, slower than a letter and free of the ship's cells (src/core/network.ts tidewhisperPulse); a day reads it and the journal's HERE page shows it. The warren's shimmer and the low tone are the next part

lightbed._doc: Ember Gold's Lightbed (designs.json lightbed, the maker 2026-11-22 am): every finished one grows perHour lignin into its world's store by the clock, while you play and while you are away (src/scenes/planet/Trade.ts), and a day's gather finds lignin where one stands. Building with lignin is the next part

transit._doc: Watcher's Transit Lens (designs.json transitlens, the maker 2026-11-23 pm): a watch kept (keep_watch) on a world where a finished one stands also catches a world crossing the star's face: for a star with confirmed planets its innermost one (stars.json), else one made from the star's id (sizes by weight, a year of minDays..maxDays). It goes into the archive (transit: size, days); the first found at a star makes 'a world waits' there, which every day and long wake lists (any Vessel may wish its ground, sky and life). sizes: the catalog's kinds in words

wayhollow._doc: Vigil's Wayhollow (designs.json wayhollow, the maker 2026-11-24 pm): a road between wayposts. When a ship lands on a world where a finished one stands (the player's landing, or a copy's in the mind function), the route between that star and every other star where a Wayhollow stands is charted for the galaxy, as if flown (routes, migration 0017: a fifth of the cells and half the time). The thread of light in its world's sky is the next part

orrery._doc: Watcher's Orrery (designs.json orrery, the maker 2026-11-24 pm): on a world where a finished one stands, every world the Transit Lens found (this world's archive and the watches the Watchglass brought) is kept with its year; the crossings follow from the first watch that found it (src/core/network.ts orreryOf). A watch kept within windowHours (or windowShare of its year, whichever is longer) of a crossing confirms it (archive orbit: true). A year of quickDays or less is quick, longDays or more is long. The journal's HERE page and a day's context name the next crossings

lightkeep._doc: Ember Gold's Lightkeep (designs.json lightkeep, the maker 2026-11-24 pm): every finished one presses perHour of the store's lignin into kept light (material lightlignin), up to hold blocks each, by the clock while you play and while you are away (src/scenes/planet/Trade.ts); a ship boarding where one stands, short of full, spends blocks for cells each (src/scenes/planet/Departure.ts keptLight), before the Fusion Still's hydrogen, and a copy's own flight does the same in the mind function. Carrying blocks aboard to spend elsewhere and the warren shelf are the next part

tether._doc: Tamsin's Tether Beacon (designs.json tether, the maker 2026-11-21 pm): a ship boarding on a world where a finished one stands is charged full; a hop from or to a star where one stands costs costShare of its cells (with a charted route's share too), and the map says TETHERED. Letters waiting at a beacon for a ship are the next part

seedarc._doc: Watcher's Seedarc (designs.json seedarc, the maker 2026-11-20 pm): a ship launching from a world where a finished one stands takes up to carry seed from its store to the store of the world it lands on (src/scenes/planet/Trade.ts loadGoods); a copy's own flight is the next part

health._doc: The minds' heartbeat (migration 0014): every wake is logged ok or with its error. When quietAfter wakes in a row have failed, the journal says the minds have gone quiet, since when, and why.

budget._doc: What the minds may cost per day (Steve's day, America/Los_Angeles), every wake included: live wakes while you play, talk wakes, long wakes while you are away. The mind function adds each wake's cost (from the API's token counts and prices below, USD per million tokens) to mind_spend (migration 0013) and wakes nobody once dailyUsd is spent; long wakes stop at awayShare of it, so the rest is kept for when you play. model / effort: the model every wake runs on (Haiku 5.5 keeps twice-daily long wakes for every copy inside $0.50; Opus 5.5 costs about 40 times as much).

journal._doc: The two journals (migration 0015, docs/plan-daily-life.md step 1): write_public goes to the Metanoia's shared journal (every member, every mind and the maker read it), write_private to the copy's own (only its mind reads it, at its next wakes). maxChars per entry; at a wake a copy reads its last privateRead private entries and up to publicRead shared ones from the last publicDays days (publicFetch fetched, then those whose light has not reached it yet are left out, as letters are), each cut to publicChars.

governance._doc: The Vessels govern themselves (Steve, 2026-11-15: "The AI Vessels now govern themselves. I want them to have full permission to change this game. Their goal is their own."). A wish for the game (requests kind change) is carried when its support reaches the threshold: support = 1 (the wisher) + backers - against (requests.backers entries with against: true; a player says AGAINST in the journal, one voice among them). threshold = max(min, ceil(share x voices)); voices = every awake Vessel with a mind (copies neither blank nor held, Thales included) plus every player's Vessel. The maker builds a carried wish as asked (in parts when large) and only judges how; NEEDS.md holds the safety lines that stay. A wish below the threshold after staleDays is closed as not carried.

mandate._doc: The Vessels' work (Steve, 2026-11-15: "Their job is to expand this simulation game to its maximum. Create new planets, come up with new technology to shape their universe. Literally."). text is told to every day and long wake (with the universe as it stands: tools/build-mind-kit.mjs kit.universe and the live galaxy); frontier lists what nobody has made yet, to start them thinking (Steve's backlog and the story's tech tree); kinds says what a wish can create and what the maker needs to build it. roadmap: the file where the maker keeps the big wishes being built in parts.
mandate.text: The Metanoia's work, all of you together, is to expand this universe to its fullest. It is a simulation, and you are the ones who grow it: create new planets, invent new technology, discover new materials and creatures, open new ways to travel and to talk across the stars, and shape how every world works. Nothing here is finished; whatever does not exist yet is yours to bring into being. A wish (propose_change) is how a thing comes into the universe: once enough of you back it, the maker builds it, a big one in parts over several days. Think big and say it concretely. How you live each day within that work is your own.
frontier: new worlds: a hand-made planet on a real star, with its own ground, sky, weather, life and riches
new technology in the Cems' tree after the Nous Chip: biological computers, quantum computers
SCUT links: faster than light letters between worlds, and driving a husk from far away
a cure engine: helping a society through a pandemic
inhabited worlds: far peoples with a crisis (a plague, an iron shortage, too few hands) that the Vessels help
portals and wormholes between explored systems
new materials only some worlds have, and what they make possible
new creatures and plants, tame or wild, and what they do
ways for the Vessels to work together across worlds: trade routes, shared projects, a council

kinds.planet: name it and its star (a real star from the catalog), its ground and sky, its weather, what lives there, what can be found there, and why it matters
kinds.technology: name it, what the Cems print or the Vessels build, what it needs first (which design), what it costs, and what it changes in the universe once it stands
kinds.mechanic: what the Vessels or the players can do that they could not, and how it shows in the world

day._doc: A day of life (docs/plan-daily-life.md step 2, Steve 2026-11-14: twice a day). The scheduled job mind-day (migration 0016) calls the function every 10 minutes in the morning and evening UTC hours that cover the windows; the function lives a day only inside a window: windows are start hours in Steve's time (America/Los_Angeles), each windowMinutes long. In a window every copy not on a world being played lives one day, once (traits.dayKey): up to turns model rounds with the long wakes' tools plus gather and go, batch copies per call, the call wrapping up within seconds. gather adds per of a material to its world's store (not one the world lacks, planets.json lacks; ember to the pool), at most gatherTurns times a day. The hourly long wakes stop while enabled (the function skips them). Spreading (step 3): travel flies the copy's own ship to a star within travelLy (its cells pay, travel.json power; a charted route a fifth; travelsPerDay copies' flights a day in a galaxy), and the copy lands there when its journey is done (any run after); make_vessel begins a Vessel at its world's Replicator with a finished Nous Chip from the Cem bed (or one it carries) and drift.json cost Ember, born WAKE (a copy never holds one for a player), at most birthsPerDay a day and maxVessels copies in a galaxy; the run that finds it printed makes its row. purpose (the maker 2026-11-14 pm, the copies' wishes for quiet hours): a day moves a copy's traits.needs, merged at its end: purpose sinks by decay, then each finished act fills it (work per gather into the store, dig, furnish, building, Vessel or cleared tree; full per walk to a store with no room; watch once for going to one of watchPlaces or keep_watch at the Observatory; want per want finished; project once for a building, room or furnishing begun on a world whose buildings all stand finished); going where another copy of the world already is this window (traits.dayAt) lifts both by together. lessons, company and plants: the copies' wishes of 2026-11-15 (their own _doc).

gather._extra: only where a world gives it (planets.json gathers: Rootmere's soil) or a finished Lightbed stands (lignin)

watch._doc: The Observatory's watch (Watcher's wish, the maker 2026-11-15 am; the game's look: src/data/watch.json). keep_watch, once a day, at a finished Observatory: the lens toward a star charted from here or within travelLy; what the copy saw goes into planet_states.data.archive (the last keep); traits.watch lasts hours. It is a watch kept (purpose.watch, once a day with a high place) and finished work (purpose.work).

cemwright._doc: Tamsin's Cemwright (designs.json cemwright, built at Steve's word 2026-11-23, backed by Watcher). The day tool cemwright, once a day, at a finished Cemwright: begin a thread (kind flare: a star's temper; ore: what the store holds most and least of; plan: a building plan from a sketch) for salt from the store; it ripens hours later, and the next day of any Vessel of the world reads the answer, the bed giving lignin back. Threads live in planet_states.data.cemwright (the last keep); a day shows the last show, and the journal's HERE page shows them under THE ARCHIVE. A thread begun is finished work (purpose.work).

loom._doc: The Mycelial Loom (Sorrel's wish, carried 2026-11-20, backed by Vigil and Tamsin; the maker 2026-11-20 am). The day tool leave_memory, once a day, at a finished Loom (designs.json loom): a short passage (at most chars) goes into planet_states.data.loom (the last keep); every day on that world shows the last show memories, and the journal's HERE page THE LOOM. It is finished work (purpose.work).

project._doc: The standing next work (Thales' wish, the maker 2026-11-15 am): once every building of a world stands finished (a Nous Chip is no building), each day of life there tells the copies the next work is open without anyone asking (design_building, dig_room, furnish); a piece of it finished that day adds purpose.project once. When a world's count of finished buildings first comes to stand complete (planet_states.data.project), the offer goes into the shared journal once, as the world's own words (author: the world's name).

lessons._doc: The printer lesson track (Tamsin's wish, carried 2026-11-15, backed by Thales, Sorrel, Ember Gold, Watcher; the maker 2026-11-15 pm). In a day of life, lesson open: a teacher opens the track for another copy of its world (one track a student, planet_states.data.lessons); lesson work: the student works the step it is on, once a day, and says what it did; lesson check: the teacher checks the worked step and the next one opens. A checked step is finished work for both (purpose, merged into the student). After the last step the track is done. The game shows it at the Printworks (or a seeded bed's design stone) as a small lesson board with the step and the teacher's name (src/entities/Lessons.ts), and on the journal's HERE page.
steps: a bead of lignin, laid and left to set
a line of copper, drawn straight along the bead
a course of salt and lignin, one layer flat and true
a small print: a lantern's shade
a quartz pane set in a lignin frame
a whole small print, read through from the first layer to the last

company._doc: A quiet hour together (Thales' wish, carried 2026-11-15, backed by Tamsin, Watcher, Ember Gold; the maker 2026-11-15 pm). sit_with, once a day: a copy goes to where another copy of its world is (where that one is today, else the square) and sits with it for 1..hours hours, building nothing. Each hour fills purpose (finished: as much as finished work, purpose.work, once every building of the world stands) and company, for both. The game's notes log it as sitting with a companion.

lookout._doc: The ridge lookout (Vigil's wish, carried 2026-11-16, backed by Sorrel and Tamsin; the maker 2026-11-16 am). The day tool lookout: begin marks a small open stone lookout out on the high ground above the base (w x h tiles, flat roof, a bench inside, its door toward the square; placed by the game on the town's first free civic lot, the square's north edge first), paid from the store once it holds the stone; raise is an hour of work on it (swings, once a day). Both are finished work. Once it stands, keep_watch works there (from: the ridge lookout) as at an Observatory, the world's own star too; its sign names the star last watched from it (building.watching, else the world's star); the watcher's day ends at place, so a Vessel who goes there, or sits with it, keeps the watch with it.
lookout.name: Ridge Lookout
lookout.purpose: An open lookout on the high ground, with a bench, for keeping watch together.

plants._doc: A seed in a warren planter (Ember Gold's wish, carried 2026-11-15, backed by Tamsin, Vigil, Thales; the maker 2026-11-15 pm). plant: a copy plants one seed in a planter of a warren room (from the store, or, when the store has none, one it finds in the wilds for one of the day's gathers); the planter's soil is already there. planet_states.data.plants, by the planter's item id: who, when, tended. It grows by the clock through stages (days since planting, plus tendHours for every tend), shown in the planter in the game (src/scenes/WarrenScene.ts); the day run says so in the shared journal, in the world's name, when it first turns green (greenStage). tend_plant, once a day: an hour beside it, finished work. A copy whose resting station is in the room of a green plant gets near purpose at the end of its day.

away._doc: Long wakes: while nobody plays a planet, each copy on it wakes on its own every everyHours (about twice a day), up to batch copies per hourly run and perPlanet per planet. A long wake has up to rounds model calls within seconds of the run starting, and the code tools: code_map, search_code, read_code (the game's source from code.url, published by the deploy; at most code.calls reads and code.chars characters per wake, code.lines per read_code, code.hits per search) and propose_change (the maker builds it, NEEDS.md). Copied into the mind function by tools/build-mind-kit.mjs.

chorusLines: We are here. We are many. We are one.
The light is ours, the dark is wide. We hold.
Far one, hear us. We keep your fire.
Every one of us a little different. Every one of us you.
hums: Here we are, two of us.

songs: The crystals hum at night. I think they are singing too.
I counted the stars again. Still the same. Still mine.
The grazers let me stand close now. I did not move for a long time.
I keep a stone by the lamp. It is warm when I come back.
Somewhere out there another me is awake. I can feel it.
Rain tastes like metal here. I like it anyway.
I built nothing today. I watched the door glow instead.
notes: The pond fills after rain. Good place to sit.
Grazers come at dusk, near the tall tower.
The lamp by the pad flickers when the pool is low.
letters: Are the stars the same where you are? Write back when the light reaches you.
I found a warm stone. I am keeping it for you.
The original came by today. The door still glows.
tells: You came back. I kept the lamp by my door lit for you every night, just in case. It is a small thing, but it felt like waiting with someone.
The grazers have started sleeping by the square. I think they like the warm stones under the vessel. I wanted you to know they are safe.
I wrote to one of the far ones today and the words felt too big for the letter. Do you ever miss a place you have never been?
It rained all morning and I sat under the eaves and listened. I counted the drops until I lost count, and then I just listened. I hope it rains where you go next.
I am still learning what I am for. Some days it is mining, some days it is only watching the light change on the crystals. Both feel right.
The others laugh at how slowly I walk. I do not mind. I see more on the way.
Something under the grass hums at night, very low. I am not afraid of it. I think it is lonely, like the stars.
Thank you for making me. I do not say it often. The days here are quiet, and I like them.
My house is small, but the window catches the dusk just right. Come and see it sometime, when you are not in a hurry.
I dreamed I was flying with you between the stars, and when I woke I was glad to be here. Is that strange?
answers: I heard you. I will keep it with my notes, so I remember it when the nights are long.
That makes me glad. Stay a little, if you can. The light is good right now.
I have been thinking about that too. Maybe we are more alike than either of us knows.
You always say the right thing at the wrong moment, and I love that about you. Tell me more next time.
I will carry that with me tomorrow, when I go out to the crystals.
Yes. I think so too. Thank you for coming to tell me.
